trades.reasoning: LOAR is the only candidate showing full multi-signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — matching our rule that true conviction requires all four signals together.

decisions.briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.7%, not a strong enough move to justify fully deploying all remaining cash. We used one of our three open slots on LOAR, the single candidate with full confirmation across RSI, MACD, price-vs-SMA20, and volume, while leaving the rest of cash in reserve until a clearer signal or stronger risk-on day appears.

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, a continuation of the broader mild uptrend rather than a sharp catalyst-driven move. No single dominant headline is available in today's feed to pin the move to, so this looks like steady, low-volatility grinding higher rather than a news-driven rally. Breadth of bullish technical setups among growth and industrial names (e.g., LOAR) suggests underlying participation is healthy even without a major macro trigger.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日股市溫和上揚,納斯達克指數升0.8%,標普500指數升0.7%,延續近期溫和上升的格局,而非由單一重大消息驅動的急漲。由於今日未有明確的重大頭條新聞可供引述,這波走勢更像是低波動、穩步向上的格局。多隻成長股及工業股(例如LOAR)出現技術面全面轉強的訊號,顯示市場參與度仍然健康,即使缺乏重大宏觀催化劑。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade idea when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and volume — all line up in agreement, rather than relying on just one. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal, since one indicator alone can give misleading readings but several agreeing together is harder to fake.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「多重訊號確認」是指只有當多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、股價與移動平均線的關係,以及成交量——同時指向同一方向時,才進行交易,而不是單靠一個指標。這樣可以降低追逐假訊號的風險,因為單一指標可能會產生誤導,但多個指標同時一致則較難是巧合。
